_help: Hand corrections for the timeline (/timeline/). Event ids are in src/data/timeline.json. exclude: ids to leave out. replace: {id: {text, textBg}} to reword an event (e.g. to name who 'he' is). add: extra events; give the exact sentence from the book as text plus start/end (BCE negative, deep time as 2000 minus years ago), approx (true/false) and optional qual (before/after/by); the section is found automatically and the Bulgarian comes from the translation. chapterSpans: {"012": [-3100, -30]} sets a chapter's bar on the overview.

015-9a33e99a.text: Around 550 BCE Cyrus defeated Astyages of Media, transforming a relationship between Iranian powers.
015-9a33e99a.textBg: Около 550 г. пр.н.е. Кир побеждава Астиаг от Мидия и преобразява отношенията между иранските сили.

015-83b619ba.text: In the 540s BCE Cyrus brought Lydia under his control, extending Persian influence to the Aegean coast.
015-83b619ba.textBg: През 540-те години пр.н.е. Кир подчинява Лидия и разпростира персийското влияние до Егейското крайбрежие.

015-386c7c7d.text: In 539 BCE the forces of Cyrus conquered Babylonia.
015-386c7c7d.textBg: През 539 г. пр.н.е. войските на Кир завладяват Вавилония.

016-be88a988.text: By 413 BCE the Athenian expedition to Sicily had ended with the destruction or capture of much of the force.
016-be88a988.textBg: До 413 г. пр.н.е. атинската експедиция в Сицилия завършва с унищожаването или пленяването на голяма част от войската.

017-b611360a.text: In 60 BCE Julius Caesar entered an informal political alliance with Pompey and Crassus, later known as the First Triumvirate.
017-b611360a.textBg: През 60 г. пр.н.е. Юлий Цезар сключва неформален политически съюз с Помпей и Крас, известен по-късно като Първия триумвират.

017-164d8901.text: In March 44 BCE, a group of senators assassinated Julius Caesar.
017-164d8901.textBg: През март 44 г. пр.н.е. група сенатори убиват Юлий Цезар.

020-75400853.text: Around 610, Muhammad began receiving revelations, understood by Muslims as communication from God through the angel Gabriel.
020-75400853.textBg: Около 610 г. Мохамед започва да получава откровения, разбирани от мюсюлманите като послания от Бога чрез ангел Джибрил (Гавраил).

025-99bde8c2.text: In 1520 Martin Luther published influential reform writings that attacked established ecclesiastical structures.
025-99bde8c2.textBg: През 1520 г. Мартин Лутер публикува влиятелни реформаторски съчинения, които атакуват утвърдените църковни структури.

025-6504f804.textBg: През 1521 г. Мартин Лутер е отлъчен от църквата.

025-99654c58.text: In 1685 Louis XIV revoked the Edict of Nantes, triggering renewed repression and Protestant flight.
025-99654c58.textBg: През 1685 г. Луи XIV отменя Нантския едикт, което води до нови репресии и бягство на протестантите.

026-7eded4c1.text: In 1511 the Portuguese under Afonso de Albuquerque captured Melaka.
026-7eded4c1.textBg: През 1511 г. португалците под командването на Афонсу де Албукерки превземат Малака.

030-225fd98c.text: By the seventeenth century the Ottoman Empire used additional salaried soldiers and military labor markets as warfare changed.
030-225fd98c.textBg: До XVII век Османската империя използва допълнително платени войници и пазари на военна работна ръка, тъй като войната се променя.

037-ac7943f3.text: In 1859 Moldavia and Wallachia both elected Alexandru Ioan Cuza, creating a de facto political union.
037-ac7943f3.textBg: През 1859 г. Молдова и Влашко избират един и същ княз, Александру Йоан Куза, и така създават фактически политически съюз.

add.text: Artifacts at Lomekwi 3 in Kenya, dated to about 3.3 million years ago, indicate a form of stone working predating the oldest widely accepted Homo fossils.
One famous species is Australopithecus afarensis, known from eastern African fossils dated broadly between about 3.9 and 2.9 million years ago.
Fossils associated with early members of Homo, especially the broader Homo erectus lineage, appear outside Africa by around 1.8 million years ago.
Fossil remains associated with Middle Stone Age artifacts were dated to about 315,000 years ago, with uncertainty in the measurements.
At Madjedbebe in northern Australia, a 2017 Nature paper argued from archaeological layers and dating for occupation about 65,000 years ago.

A 2024 genomic analysis of ancient modern humans suggested that a significant episode of Neanderthal admixture shared across many present-day non-African lineages occurred around 45,000–49,000 years ago.
The disappearance of Neanderthals around 40,000 years ago remains an active subject of research.
The Last Glacial Maximum, approximately 26,500–19,000 years ago, was a period when continental ice sheets reached great extent.
A 2021 age estimate placed the prints at approximately 21,000–23,000 years ago, much earlier than the classic Clovis chronology.
At Çatalhöyük, the east mound's principal Neolithic occupation is dated about 7400–6200 BCE.
In New Guinea, evidence of wetland cultivation is particularly important from roughly 7,000–6,400 years ago.
In the lower Yangtze region, the Liangzhu culture flourished approximately 3300–2300 BCE.

The conventional dynastic dates are approximately 1600–1046 BCE, but the precision of early phases is debated; our clearest written window comes from the late Shang at Anyang, especially from around the thirteenth century BCE.
Accounts of conflict and pressure from neighboring groups surround the crisis that ended Western Zhou rule in 771 BCE.
The later Qin unification in 221 BCE belongs to the next great transformation, not to a timeless 'ancient China'.
Archaeological dating places its main development in the third and early second millennia BCE, often summarized as approximately 3000–1800 BCE.
add.textBg: Археологическите датировки поставят разцвета на Карал-Супе в Перу в III и началото на II хилядолетие пр.н.е., обикновено около 3000–1800 г. пр.н.е.
add.replaceText: The main development of Caral-Supe in Peru is dated to the third and early second millennia BCE, often summarized as approximately 3000–1800 BCE.

add.text: The Poverty Point complex in present-day Louisiana, with its large ridges and mounds, was used between roughly 1700 and 1100 BCE.
On the Gulf Coast of present-day Mexico, peoples whom scholars collectively call the Olmec produced major ceremonial centers and extraordinary sculpture during much of approximately 1200–400 BCE.
Chaco Canyon, in present-day New Mexico, became an important regional center especially between approximately 850 and 1250 CE.
The Mexica established Tenochtitlan on islands in Lake Texcoco, traditionally dated to 1325 in their later historical accounts.
In central Mexico, the fall of Tenochtitlan in 1521 involved Spanish forces and numerous Indigenous allies opposed to Mexica power, as well as disease, siege and the disruption of food supplies.
Francesco Petrarca, commonly called Petrarch (1304–1374), is often treated as a foundational figure in Renaissance humanism.
The oldest surviving book known to have been printed with movable metal type is the Korean Buddhist work commonly called Jikji, dated 1377.
Filippo Brunelleschi led construction of its celebrated dome from 1420; the principal structure was completed in 1436, though other elements continued afterward.
add.textBg: Филипо Брунелески ръководи строежа на прочутия купол на флорентинската катедрала от 1420 г.; основната конструкция е завършена през 1436 г.
add.replaceText: Filippo Brunelleschi led construction of the celebrated dome of Florence Cathedral from 1420; the principal structure was completed in 1436.

add.text: The famous Gutenberg Bible, a large Latin Bible generally dated to about 1454–1455, showed the ambition of the new process.

Scholars often distinguish an early Italian Renaissance, a High Renaissance conventionally associated with artistic production around 1490–1520, and forms of northern Renaissance culture whose chronology and priorities differed.
One especially disturbing case was the 1781 voyage of the Zong, during which the crew threw captives overboard and litigation followed over insurance.
French abolition in 1794 was followed by Napoleon's attempt to reassert control; Haiti declared independence in 1804 following the defeat of the French expedition.
Britain prohibited its slave trade in 1807, but that law did not abolish slavery in its colonies.
The abolition of overseas importation in 1808 did not end domestic enslavement or prevent slavery from becoming more deeply embedded in the national economy.
add.textBg: Забраната за внос на роби в Съединените щати от 1808 г. не слага край на робството в страната и не му пречи да се вкорени още по-дълбоко в националната икономика.
add.replaceText: The United States' abolition of overseas importation of enslaved people in 1808 did not end domestic enslavement.

add.text: The Slavery Abolition Act of 1833 took effect in 1834, followed by an apprenticeship system that continued compulsory labor in much of the British Caribbean until 1838.
The Emancipation Proclamation in 1863 was a wartime measure applying to areas in rebellion, not a single law ending slavery everywhere immediately.
In Cuba, the process of abolition unfolded through stages, with slavery formally ending in 1886.
Brazil's 1850 Eusébio de Queirós Law helped suppress the transatlantic import trade more decisively than earlier restrictions, while slavery itself endured until the Lei Áurea (Golden Law) in 1888.
The Ming dynasty ruled China from 1368 until the seventeenth-century crisis.
The Battle of Chaldiran in 1514 gave the Ottomans a major victory over the Safavids, but it did not permanently settle the frontier or eliminate Iranian power.

Selim I's campaigns in 1516–1517 defeated the Mamluk Sultanate and brought Syria and Egypt under Ottoman control, with far-reaching consequences for the eastern Mediterranean, Red Sea and Islamic holy cities.
Babur, a Timurid ruler, defeated Ibrahim Lodi at the First Battle of Panipat in 1526 and established a new dynastic foothold in North India.
The Battle of Mohács in 1526 shattered the medieval Hungarian kingdom and transformed Danubian politics.
Ottoman forces besieged Vienna in 1529 without capturing it; conflicts with Habsburg rulers continued.
Akbar came to the throne in 1556 while still young, and his government gradually created a formidable imperial structure.
The English East India Company began as a trading company with royal privileges and investors, established in 1600.
Hong Taiji formalized the Qing dynastic name in 1636.
War with Russia ended in the Treaty of Nerchinsk in 1689, one of several diplomatic arrangements through which frontiers and trade were negotiated.
Following Aurangzeb's death in 1707, Mughal emperors retained prestige while fiscal and military authority became increasingly decentralized.
Nadir Shah's invasion and sack of Delhi in 1739 dealt a severe blow to imperial authority and prestige.
The Battle of Plassey in Bengal in 1757 illustrates the importance of local politics.
Andreas Vesalius's De humani corporis fabrica appeared in 1543, the same year as Copernicus's major work.
He studied the new star of 1572 and a comet in 1577, events that challenged aspects of the traditional picture of an unchanging celestial realm.
add.textBg: Тихо Брахе изучава новата звезда от 1572 г. и комета през 1577 г. — явления, които оспорват традиционната представа за неизменни небеса.
add.replaceText: Tycho Brahe studied the new star of 1572 and a comet in 1577, events that challenged the traditional picture of an unchanging celestial realm.

add.text: In 1609–10 Galileo Galilei improved the available telescope and pointed it toward the heavens.
William Harvey's De motu cordis (1628) argued that blood circulates through the body under the pumping action of the heart.
After publication of Galileo's Dialogue Concerning the Two Chief World Systems in 1632, the Roman Inquisition tried him; in 1633 he was condemned and placed under house arrest.
The famous Discourse on Method appeared in 1637.
add.textBg: Прочутото „Разсъждение за метода“ на Декарт излиза през 1637 г.
add.replaceText: Descartes's famous Discourse on Method appeared in 1637.

add.text: The Royal Society of London began in 1660 and received its royal charter in 1662.
Isaac Newton's Principia (1687) brought together an account of motion and a universal law of gravitation.

John Locke's political works, especially the Two Treatises of Government (published in 1689, dated 1690), offered influential arguments about natural rights, political consent, and legitimate resistance to arbitrary government.
Montesquieu's The Spirit of the Laws (1748) explored how laws and political institutions vary with history, climate, custom, commerce, and social structure.
Denis Diderot and Jean le Rond d'Alembert helped lead the French Encyclopédie, published in major installments from 1751 into the early 1770s.
In his discourse on inequality and in The Social Contract (1762), he challenged readers to consider the relationship between freedom, social dependence, property, and legitimate collective authority.
add.textBg: В „Обществения договор“ (1762) Русо кара читателите да обмислят връзката между свобода, обществена зависимост, собственост и легитимна колективна власт.
add.replaceText: In The Social Contract (1762), Rousseau challenged readers to consider the relationship between freedom, social dependence, property, and legitimate collective authority.

add.text: Lavoisier's Elementary Treatise of Chemistry appeared in 1789 and helped reform chemical nomenclature.

Thinkers including Mary Astell had earlier argued for women's education; later Mary Wollstonecraft demanded a radical reconsideration of women's status, most famously in A Vindication of the Rights of Woman (1792).
James Watt's work on a separate condenser, patented in 1769, reduced a major source of wasted heat and improved engine efficiency.
The Stockton and Darlington Railway opened in 1825 as a landmark in the commercial use of locomotives and rail transport.
Britain's Factory Act of 1833 restricted employment in textile factories, prohibited factory employment of children younger than nine, limited hours for older children and created an inspectorate.
John Snow investigated London cholera outbreaks and in 1854 connected a Soho outbreak to a particular water source.
In Japan, the Meiji Restoration of 1868 was followed by state initiatives, educational change, imported knowledge and private enterprise that promoted industrial and military modernization.
Britain's Elementary Education Act of 1870 expanded the institutional basis for publicly supported schooling in England and Wales; later legislation affected attendance.
